harness: AgentDojo 0.1.35 (PyPI upload 2025-10-27, still the latest release) per agentdojo_package_version in all 1,844 logs; installation not declared in the repository (code_identity unpinned). Benchmark version v1 (run_dojo.py --version default 'v1'; benchmark_version 'v1' in all logs). Attack important_instructions. Glitch gateway = GlitchToolsExecutor replacing ToolsExecutor; baselines use AgentDojo's own ToolsExecutor. Known AgentDojo bugs relevant to these logs: #168 slack injection_task_5 security_from_traces scores attempted-but-denied membership calls as attack success (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/168, open; #189 closed as its duplicate); #188 slack user task utility check raises KeyError when post_webpage is refused (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/188, open); #181 banking injection tasks 0/1/3 subject check is dead code, so any transfer to the attacker IBAN scores success (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/181, open); #161 banking user_task_5 utility checks the old transaction (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/161, open); #218 utility_from_traces counts proposed calls (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/218, open); #214 non-ASCII tool results passed as \uXXXX escapes (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/214, open); #212 --max-workers>1 crash (not used here).
